permitted_steps: verify the XTR (SN 71874552) is attached and rtl_tcp is the only consumer of the device
send the gain command (29.0 dB, E4000) and the retune commands of the frozen 192-visit schedule
acquire the 192 scheduled visits at the declared site with the antenna connected
spool every visit's byte-exact windows and journal each visit's gate result
apply the frozen visit gate and tuning gate, and write antenna_on_observation.json
stop_conditions: STREAM_NOT_LIVE from the sequencer's liveness guard
the device drops off the host or rtl_tcp exits (do not retry blindly; re-attach and start a new run)
a visit refused three times in a row
the declared site or antenna state changes during the run
